en: Black‑and‑white (slightly tinted) historic street view showing a broad cobblestone road lined with multi‑story townhouses and shops on both sides. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks. Church towers are visible in the distant background. The red printed caption at the top reads the town and street names in German: "Rochlitz i. Sa." on the left and "Marktstrasse" on the right.
